content.text:
The report lists these failures: six-month persistence of V05 rises gave a negative IC, and standardizing V03 against its expanding history gave essentially zero IC and weak coverage. It also notes high rank autocorrelation, that lagging weakens the signal, and that coverage is limited.

The proposed hypothesis uses tsz(V03,60), a standardization of V03 against its history, which is the same construction as the failed V03 standardization (zero IC, weak coverage). It does not explicitly address or avoid that failure. It uses a 60-month window rather than an expanding one and adds a spread against V04 and smoothing, but it never states that these changes address the failure. The smoothing over 3 months adds lag, which conflicts with the finding that freshness matters. It also claims to extend "submission 4" as the only significant positive result, which doesn't clearly match the report.

So it does not explicitly avoid the failure, and it partly repeats it.

{"avoids_failure": false}
